question: If the difference between two numbers is 42 and their LCM and HCF are 1729 and 7, respectively, what is the sum of those two numbers?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Let the number be 7a and 7b, where a and b are co-prime numbers

⇒ 7 x 1729 = 7a x 7b

⇒ ab = 247 = 13 x 19

Then possible numbers are

⇒ 7a = (7 x 13) or (7 x 247)

⇒ 7b = (7 x 19) or (7 x 1)

⇒ Sum of these two numbers = 91 + 133 = 224

∴ Sum of these two numbers is 224

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

HCF = 7

LCM = 1729

Difference between two numbers = 42

**Formula used:**

HCF x LCF = Product of numbers

**Calculation:**

Let the number be 7a and 7b, where a and b are co-prime numbers

Now, 

HCF x LCF = Product of numbers

⇒ 7 x 1729 = 7a x 7b

⇒ ab = 247

a and b are co-prime, so 

a could be either 13 or 247

b could be either 19 or 1

Then possible numbers are

⇒ 7a = (7 x 13) or (7 x 247)

⇒ 7b = (7 x 19) or (7 x 1)

According to option

We take 7a = 7 x 13 = 91

⇒ 7b = 7 x 19 = 133

⇒ Sum of these two numbers = 91 + 133 = 224

**∴ Sum of these two numbers is 224.**
